title: Abel and Yeshua killed by brothers unjustly
summary: Genesis 4:8 (Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him) and Matthew 26:65-66 (the high priest and council declare Jesus deserving of death) frame the conclusion that Abel and Yeshua (Jesus) were both killed unjustly by their brothers.

text.text: 8 And Cain said to Abel his brother; and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.
Abel & yeshua killed by brothers unjustly
65 Then the high priest tears his garments, saying, “He has blasphemed; why do we have any more need of witnesses? Behold now, you have heard the blasphemy.
66 What do you think?” And answering they said, “He is deserving of death.”

themes: Abel as a type of Christ
